title: B2 Milestone 6: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el Sexto Hito del Nivel B2. Tu comprensión de las sutilezas gramaticales y el léxico ejecutivo te posiciona como un hablante de alto nivel en el mundo de los negocios.

parts.visual:
En este hito repasaremos las lecciones 26 a 29 del nivel B2: 
- Gerunds vs Infinitives (Verbos como stop, remember, regret). 
- Future in the Past (I was going to, I was about to).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 26 to 29 of the B2 level: Gerunds versus Infinitives with verbs that change meaning, and Future in the Past.

parts.visual:
También evaluaremos tu uso de vocabulario avanzado: 
- Phrasal Verbs 2 (Rule out, phase out, set up, step down). 
- Business Idioms 2 (Red tape, read between the lines, get the sack). 
¡Demuestra que puedes manejar discusiones corporativas complejas!
parts.audio: We will also test your advanced vocabulary: Phrasal Verbs part 2, and Business Idioms part 2. Show that you can handle complex corporate discussions!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador B2.

questions.question: I completely forgot ____ my boss about the meeting. I'll do it now! (Deber futuro/presente).
questions.explanation: Forget + TO = olvidar hacer algo que debías hacer.

questions.question: I remember ____ the document, but I can't find it. (Recuerdo haberlo firmado).
questions.explanation: Remember + ING = memoria de algo que ya pasó.

questions.question: The company regrets ____ that 50 employees will be laid off. (Lamenta informar - formal).
questions.explanation: Regret + TO (announce/inform) = informar de una mala noticia.

questions.question: He stopped ____ coffee because his doctor told him to. (Dejó el hábito).
questions.explanation: Stop + ING = abandonar un hábito o acción.

questions.question: We ____ going to open a branch in Tokyo, but the crisis stopped us. (Íbamos a).
The CEO ____ supposed to arrive at 9 AM. (Se suponía que llegaría).
I was just ____ to send the email when you called. (Estaba a punto de).
He told me that the project ____ be very difficult. (Que el proyecto sería).
We can't ____ out the possibility of a hostile takeover. (Descartar).
After 20 years, the founder decided to ____ down. (Dimitir).
They will ____ out the old software over the next six months. (Retirar gradualmente).
We need to ____ up a meeting with the investors. (Organizar).
There is too much red ____ to get anything done in this country. (Burocracia).
If you read between the ____, you'll see they are running out of money. (Deducir lo que no se dice).
If you don't improve your performance, you will get the ____. (Ser despedido).
It takes about a month to learn the ____ in this department. (Aprender las nociones básicas).
I regret ____ that stock. It lost 50% of its value. (Me arrepiento de haber comprado).
questions.explanation: Regret + ING = arrepentirse de una acción del pasado.

questions.question: They were ____ to sign the contract, but the lawyer stopped them. (Teníamos previsto / Iban a - formal).
questions.explanation: They were to sign = plan oficial formal (también podría ser 'about to sign' dependiendo del matiz, pero 'to' es gramática pura de 'was to / were to'). En las opciones, si aparece 'about' tendría que ser 'about to sign'. Como el hueco es sólo uno, 'about' dejaría 'were about to sign', la cual tiene 'to' en la oración original. Así que: They were [about] to sign. Correcto. (Ambas funcionan). Asumamos 'about' como más común para 'a punto de'.

questions.question: We are currently in the ____, losing thousands every day. (En números rojos).
I tried ____ the password, but the account is locked. (Esfuerzo fallido o experimento fallido).
questions.explanation: Try + ING (hacer la prueba) o Try + TO + infinitive. En las opciones 'entering' es la única gramaticalmente correcta (to entering es incorrecto).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave del nivel B2.

questions.question: Stop ____ (smoke). (Dejar el hábito)
Remember ____ (call) me later. (Acordarse de - obligación)
We ____ going to launch it. (Íbamos a)
I was ____ to leave. (A punto de)
____ out the possibility. (Descartar con R)
____ down from the position. (Dimitir con S)
Red ____. (Burocracia con T)
Learn the ____. (Aprender las bases con R)
Read between the ____. (Entre líneas con L)
Get the ____. (Ser despedido con S)
